business_problem: As Plex Coffee expanded from one café to four, it needed a better way to train rotating staff, preserve service culture, and stop store managers from being overwhelmed by repetitive knowledge-sharing questions.
solution_summary: Plex Coffee uses ChatGPT Business to turn onboarding and store operations into conversational workflows that scale more cleanly than handbooks and messaging threads. The team first centralized knowledge in Notion, then enabled the Notion connector so staff could ask natural-language questions from an in-store iPad and receive answers grounded in the café’s documentation instead of flooding WhatsApp groups. For onboarding, founder-written training material was converted into a custom GPT that teaches company values, drink preparation, sourcing, and procedures in a more engaging conversational style than a 25-page manual. Once those flows stabilized, Plex extended ChatGPT Business into expansion research, demand analysis, and supply-order experimentation, using deep-research features and Agent workflows to estimate revenue, explain unusual demand patterns, and reduce repetitive vendor administration. The result is a lean hospitality operation where AI handles knowledge retrieval and prep work so managers can focus on guests and community.

data_flow: Operational documents from Notion are pulled into ChatGPT Business through the connector so staff can retrieve answers on demand. Handbook content is loaded into the onboarding GPT, while managers use the same workspace to analyze demand, research expansion, and experiment with supplier-order automation.
business_outcome: Plex Coffee reduced operational messaging noise, accelerated onboarding, freed store managers for more guest and community engagement, and built a scalable knowledge-sharing model for future expansion.
